svg.metadata: {"story":"Isaiah","act":2,"chapter":"Ch.2 · The Holy Throne","scene":"B","layer":"foreground","artDirection":"In the year King Uzziah died, Isaiah sees the Lord on a throne, high and lifted up, with seraphim crying holy, holy, holy. Stage: a temple in a vision, the throne filling the hall, a train of fire, six-winged seraphim, an altar coal touching the prophet's lips; blinding, trembling light.","materials":["assets/materials/stone-flagstone.svg","assets/materials/hammered_gold-hammered.svg","assets/materials/water_still-eddies.svg"],"seed":1}
